source_bound_semantics.activation: readswap enables the KSATEXM branch when a KSATEXM value is supplied and KSATEXM > KSATFIT
source_bound_semantics.threshold_state: relative saturation and base MvG conductivity are evaluated at h=-2 cm
source_bound_semantics.conductivity_above_threshold: for relsat > relsatthr and no macropore override, K is linearly interpolated in relative saturation between K(h=-2) and KSATEXM at saturation
source_bound_semantics.conductivity_below_threshold: the normal Mualem-van Genuchten conductivity using KSATFIT and LEXP applies
source_bound_semantics.catalog_relation: all frozen Staringreeks 2018 rows have KSATEXM > KSATFIT
source_bound_semantics.gate_b_and_c1_relation: Gate B and C1 deliberately disabled KSATEXM; therefore their h in [-2,-1] cm results do not represent the full Staringreeks KSATEXM-enabled conductivity semantics.

qualification_consequence: KSATEXM must be a separate Gate C subgate after a bounded base unimodal catalog representation has been resolved. It may not be silently folded into or inferred from C1.
